from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSReport(BaseModel):
    """Diluted EPS data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="The diluted earnings per share value; losses are negative")
    eps_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of EPS, e.g., '元/股'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="Where in the report the EPS was found, e.g., '主要会计数据和财务指标' or '合并利润表'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_reports: list[CompanyEPSReport]
